## Term

The term to consider adding.

## Profile

Target profile (e.g., software-docs-en)

## Suggested status

- [ ] preferred
- [ ] allowed
- [ ] discouraged
- [ ] observed

## Evidence

Why should this term be added? Include references to documentation, standards, or corpus evidence.

## Alternatives

Any alternatives the term should be paired with (e.g., "use" for "utilize").
